description: We are a mixed team, with several enthusiasts in programming, art and technology.
summary:
We used Godot 4 to create a game about creating a biosphere on the moon, the 3D models were downloaded from the internet. Just like certain images, some images were made by us. For the code we relied on ziba AI that uses deepseek in addition to our own efforts, after a lot of trial and error we managed to finish it. Enjoy.               
 PS: Try pressing the key combination: s,s,w,w,w,k,k. and you will obtain crucial items. (if you want to feel the real experience this is not recommended)
details: Our project is a video game/simulator of surviving on the moon, we tried to make the mechanics as realistic as possible without being too complex for the player or for us when programming it, we did not have much time for the animations because they are simple or non-existent but we put a lot of effort into all the possible details, in a part of the game near the end you will be able to find Noé, a mannequin that we placed during development as a prototype of the player who We decided to leave it as an Easter egg. The game is simple: You crashed on the moon and you must survive. 1, extract dust from the surface, 2 place the dust in the extractor to extract the minerals, 3 process them and melt them in the oven, 3 In the 3D printer with the materials you can create various things such as a drill to speed up the excavation or oxygen to breathe (Moon dust contains oxygen) but the most important thing is the greenhouse and the pots that will allow you to plant the plants, 4 Place the greenhouse, place the pots inside it, nearby you will find a capsule with the seeds, archaea (which you must place in the reactor to get water) and worms, place the worms in the ground followed by the water and finally the seeds, which after about 2 minutes will grow, finishing the mission
